issues.issue: [fixed 2026-10-28: category set to Debt Service with debt_service_part principal] This is a debt service principal line. Under the rules it belongs in category 'Debt Service' with debt_service_part 'principal', not public safety. The governmental funds statement (p6) also counts it under 'Principal payments on debt' (General Fund 18,156).

[fixed 2026-10-28: category set to Debt Service with debt_service_part interest] This is a debt service interest line. It belongs in category 'Debt Service' with debt_service_part 'interest', not public safety. The p6 statement counts it under 'Interest on long-term debt' (General Fund 168).

issues.issue: The category and detail_category disagree. Rural fire contract payments are listed as charges for services/fees in the rules, but the label says reimbursements and the page prints the line under intergovernmental revenue.
The grantor is not stated, so federal grants is a guess (detail[12] is the same). The line already has a review note.
This is a legal settlement, not a refund or insurance proceeds. The category is defensible but uncertain.

The Statement of Activities (p3) shows this as Capital Grants and Contributions, and the cash flow statement (p12) lists it under capital and related financing. It could belong in business_type.other_financing as a capital contribution rather than in receipts.
The 'Transportation' object lines (Police, Library, Park, Cemetery, Fire) were coded as dues, training and travel. They may be vehicle or fuel costs, so this is a judgement call.
